caption: The drawing features two views of a dress on a plain, light beige background. The main view, depicted in the foreground, shows the front of a gown with a fitted bodice and a wide, bell-shaped skirt that reaches near the bottom of the page. The bodice is light in color, likely white or cream, and is decorated with small, colorful floral patterns consisting mainly of blue, pink, and green hues. Gold or yellow lines run vertically along the bodice, resembling boning or decorative trim, and the neckline is wide with short, off-the-shoulder sleeves featuring simple linear accents. The skirt is large and unadorned, outlined clearly in black with no fill color. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller, more simplified line drawing of the same dress showing the back view. The back illustration indicates a row of buttons or closures down the center of the bodice and gives a sense of symmetry with the front. Both the main and smaller drawing are sketch-like, with the use of pencil lines and minimal shading except for the colored details on the bodice in the main figure.
